summary: Monday's session sets up as a balance between solid foreign buying and a strong Wall Street lead, and the oil risk from Gulf tensions and a contested OPEC+ meeting on Sunday.

top.title: Iraq pushes OPEC+ for a bigger quota
top.line: Baghdad is seeking a higher ceiling ahead of Sunday's meetings on 2027 output
more: Iraq's quota is 4.431 million bpd; it says it can pump 5.2 million
An OPEC+ review puts Iraq's capacity at about 4.9 million bpd, which Baghdad disputes
The group's output framework expires on 31 December 2026
